projects.name: OpenRA Mod SDK
projects.content_policy: example content; verify each asset before reuse
projects.reuse_role: canonical SDK layout, packaging, linting, and minimal mod examples

projects.name: Combined Arms
projects.content_policy: mixed provenance; quarantine all binary assets pending credits review
projects.reuse_role: broad faction, unit, support-power, AI, naval, air, and campaign reference

projects.name: Generals Alpha
projects.content_policy: uses Red Alert and Tiberian Dawn artwork; do not import binary assets without separate clearance
projects.reuse_role: modern asymmetric factions, generals points, upgrades, powers, aircraft, and strategy AI

projects.name: RA+
projects.content_policy: contains Westwood artwork and sounds; mechanics only until per-asset clearance
projects.reuse_role: country and subfaction architecture, national bonuses, rosters, and build-tree variants

projects.name: Shattered Paradise
projects.content_policy: non-code assets are CC-BY-NC-4.0; reference-only for a distributable commercial-capable build
projects.reuse_role: complete new factions, Tiberian Sun systems, mutation mechanics, effects, and advanced traits

projects.name: Romanov's Vengeance
projects.content_policy: requires owned Red Alert 2/Yuri's Revenge content and contains mixed placeholders; mechanics only by default
projects.reuse_role: RA2 factions, garrisons, mind control, upgrades, amphibious systems, and production logic

projects.name: OpenRA Red Alert 2
projects.content_policy: original game content is not covered by the code license; mechanics only by default
projects.reuse_role: cleaner upstream RA2 architecture and baseline behavior

projects.name: Cameo
projects.content_policy: mixed non-free content; original developer art is CC-BY-NC-4.0; no binary import by default
projects.reuse_role: experimental mechanic library: commander trees, status systems, weather, upgrades, factions, and naval options

projects.name: OpenHV
projects.content_policy: per-folder Creative Commons licenses; import only after resolving and recording the exact asset license
projects.reuse_role: open-content units, art and sound pipeline, bots, maps, missions, and standalone game patterns
